items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: So we worked at the Club Royal... Wilbur played the bass violin and tipple.

ctx.x: Yeah. They worked -- not they, I didn't mean that. We, rather, worked the Club Royal and Doug and Wilbur somehow they could not and did not get along well, and the longer the job lasted the worse they got. Brothers, two brothers. They fought like dogs. And unfortunately, one of the brothers, who was Doug, he was an epileptic, and then he began to have these seizures, you know, the epileptic seizures, and this happened a couple of times on the job and scared the heck out of everybody, me and everybody else in the…
